solution.approach: Compute sum and product of odd and even digits separately.

code.Python3:
import sys
def main():
    toks = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not toks: return
    s = toks[0]
    so = sum(int(c) for c in s if int(c) % 2 != 0)
    se = sum(int(c) for c in s if int(c) % 2 == 0)
    po = 1; has_o = False
    for c in s:
        if int(c) % 2 != 0: po *= int(c); has_o = True
    pe = 1; has_e = False
    for c in s:
        if int(c) % 2 == 0: pe *= int(c); has_e = True
    if not has_o: po = 0
    if not has_e: pe = 0
    print(f"Sum of Odd:{so}\nSum of Even:{se}\nProduct of ODD:{po}\nProduct of Even:{pe}")
if __name__ == "__main__": main()

solution.editorial: Iterate through digits, accumulating sums and products for odd and even digits.
